detail.title: Amazon fulfillment
detail.simulatedNotice: This is a test run. No Amazon order was placed and no money was charged — the costs and profit below are simulated.
detail.actionRequiredNotice: Automation stopped before buying. Review the reason and fulfill this order manually.
detail.cancelledNotice: The Amazon purchase was cancelled. The eBay sale is still owed to the buyer — fulfill it another way.
detail.notAutomatedNotice: Automatic ordering is off for this order.

problem.wrongPageType: The tracking provider could not read Amazon's order page — it may have changed format. This will be retried automatically.
problem.amazonSessionExpired: The Amazon session used to read this order has expired and needs to be signed in again.
problem.trackingUrlMismatch: The tracking link on Amazon's order page did not match what we expected. This will be retried automatically.
problem.needsTrackingUpload: Waiting on the shipment details to be uploaded before the tracking number can be converted.
problem.updateNotApplied: The tracking update has not been applied by the provider yet. This will be retried automatically.
problem.assignValidation: The tracking provider rejected the shipment details for this order.
problem.shipmentException: The tracking provider reported an exception on this shipment.
problem.trackingUpdateUnavailable: The tracking provider could not update this shipment right now.
problem.generic: There is a problem with this order's tracking conversion. It will be retried automatically.

reason.order_cancelled: Cancelled on eBay — nothing to buy
reason.multi_item_order: Order has several items — buy by hand
reason.cancel_requested: Buyer asked to cancel — answer on eBay

start.confirmTitle: Buy this order on Amazon now?
start.confirmDescription: SellerHill will place a real Amazon order for this sale with your automatic-order Amazon account, shipped to the eBay buyer. Your spending cap still applies, and the purchase stops if the total is over it. Only continue if you have not already bought the item yourself.
start.queued: The purchase has started. The order's status updates in a few minutes.
start.queuedDryRun: A test run has started. This Amazon account is in test mode, so nothing will be bought.

notPurchased.confirmTitle: Confirm that Amazon has no order for this sale?
notPurchased.confirmDescription: Only continue after you have looked at this Amazon account's orders and the order is not there. SellerHill checks the account's order list too and refuses until that check has run. Afterwards the automatic order can be started again — if the order does exist on Amazon, the item would be bought twice.
notPurchased.done: Marked as not purchased. You can start the automatic order again.

detail.title: Order Details
detail.subtitle: Payment, Amazon cost, delivery and order progress
detail.notFoundSubtitle: This order may have been removed or you do not have access.
detail.analysisDesc: This calculation factors in your actual earnings from eBay after all platform fees and taxes, subtracted by the original Amazon purchase cost.
detail.cancelledAmazonOpenAction: An Amazon order was already placed for this sale. Cancel it on Amazon, or return the item if it has shipped.
detail.multiItemNotice: This eBay order holds {{count}} items. SellerHill tracks only the first one and does not buy this order automatically — buy and ship the other items yourself.

modal.title: Enter Amazon Order Info

errors.noTrackingYet: This order has no Amazon tracking number yet — it has not shipped.
errors.conversionUnavailable: Tracking could not be converted right now. Check your plan limit and conversion settings, then try again.
errors.orderNotTracked: This order is not linked to one of your listings, so a converted tracking number could never be sent to eBay. Link the order to its listing first.
errors.trackingAlreadyPushed: eBay already has the original tracking number for this order and it cannot be replaced, so converting now would not change what the buyer sees.
errors.listingOverPlanLimit: This order's listing was outside your plan's listing limit when the order arrived. Orders from listings outside the limit get no shipment tracking or tracking conversion.
errors.storeNotConnected: This order's eBay store is not connected. Reconnect the store, then convert the tracking number.
errors.autoFulfillNotRestartable: The automatic purchase for this order can't be started again. It may already be bought or in progress, or a second purchase could be placed. Check your Amazon orders and link the order by hand.
errors.autoFulfillNoAccount: No Amazon account is ready for automatic orders. In Settings, turn on automatic orders for an Amazon account and set a spending cap.
errors.autoFulfillOverCap: This sale is over your Amazon account's spending cap. Raise the cap in the Amazon account's settings, or buy the item by hand.
errors.autoFulfillAlreadyStarted: This order's status changed a moment ago, so the purchase may already have started. Refresh the page.
errors.autoFulfillQuotaExhausted: Your plan's automatic order limit for this period is used up.
errors.purchaseNotYetChecked: SellerHill has not yet checked this Amazon account's orders since the purchase attempt. The check has now been started — try again in a few minutes.
errors.purchaseNotUnknown: This order is not waiting for a purchase confirmation. It may already be linked or in progress. Refresh the page.
errors.purchaseFoundOnAmazon: SellerHill found an Amazon order for this product, placed around the time of the purchase attempt, but could not match it to this sale with certainty. Open your Amazon orders and link it by hand. If that order belongs to another sale, link it to that sale first.
errors.noteTooLong: The note can be at most 1,000 characters.
errors.noteInvalid: The note could not be saved.

amazon_cancelled.label: Amazon cancelled
amazon_cancelled.meaning: Amazon cancelled the purchase. The eBay buyer is still owed the item.
amazon_cancelled.action: Fulfil this order another way, then link the new Amazon order.

delivered.label: Delivered
delivered.meaning: Amazon reports the parcel delivered. Nothing left to do.

test_run.label: Test run
test_run.meaning: A dry run of automatic ordering. No Amazon order was placed and no money moved.

shipped.label: Shipped
shipped.meaning: Tracking has been sent to eBay. Waiting for delivery.

tracking_held.label: Tracking held
tracking_held.meaning: Amazon shipped, but the tracking has not reached eBay yet — usually the tracking conversion is still pending.
tracking_held.action: Convert the tracking, or fix the cause shown on the order.

buying.label: Buying on Amazon
buying.meaning: Automatic ordering is placing this order on Amazon right now.

purchased.label: Purchased · awaiting shipment
purchased.meaning: An Amazon order is linked. Waiting for Amazon to ship it.

purchase_unknown.label: Purchase not confirmed
purchase_unknown.meaning: The order button was pressed on Amazon, but no confirmation came back. The order may exist.
purchase_unknown.action: Check your Amazon orders first. If the order is there, link it. Do not buy it again before you have checked.

purchase_blocked.label: Purchase blocked
purchase_blocked.meaning: Automatic ordering stopped at a safety check before buying. No money moved.
purchase_blocked.action: Fix the reason shown, or buy on Amazon by hand and link the order.

awaiting_payment.label: Awaiting payment
awaiting_payment.meaning: The buyer has not paid yet. Do not buy until they do.

to_purchase.label: To purchase
to_purchase.meaning: Paid, and no Amazon order is linked yet.
to_purchase.action: Buy on Amazon and link the order.

note.bought_auto: The automatic order bought the item on Amazon.
note.bought_linked: An Amazon order is linked to this sale.
note.purchase_not_recorded: SellerHill holds no Amazon order for this sale.
note.amazon_shipped: Amazon handed the parcel to the carrier.
note.waiting_shipment: Waiting for Amazon to ship. The order is checked at regular intervals.
note.shipment_not_observed: SellerHill did not follow an Amazon shipment for this sale.
note.upcoming_shipment: Appears here once Amazon ships the parcel.
note.tracking_pushed: The tracking number was sent to eBay; your buyer can follow the parcel.
note.tracking_not_by_us: SellerHill did not send the tracking number for this sale.
note.upcoming_tracking: Sent to eBay once Amazon ships the parcel.
note.delivered: Amazon reports the parcel as delivered.
note.waiting_delivery: Waiting for delivery. The order is checked at regular intervals.
note.delivery_not_tracked: SellerHill is not following the delivery of this sale.
note.upcoming_delivery: Appears here once the parcel is delivered.

reasons.BUYER_CANCEL_OR_ADDRESS_ISSUE: Buyer cancelled or has an address problem
reasons.OUT_OF_STOCK_OR_CANNOT_FULFILL: Out of stock or cannot fulfil
